query: Who was elected pope in 2025, and what name did he take?
answer: On May 8, 2025, the cardinals elected American Cardinal Robert Francis Prevost pope, and he took the name Leo XIV [1][2]. He was born in Chicago and spent many years as a missionary in Peru. At the time of his election he was prefect of the Dicastery for Bishops. He is the first U.S.-born pope and the 267th pontiff [2]. The conclave met May 7–8, 2025, after Pope Francis died in April, and chose Prevost on its fourth ballot [1]. The Vatican said the name Leo was a clear reference to the Church's social teaching, which points back to Pope Leo XIII [1].
